initial_application: Jira says the change was pre-applied in svn revision 13313. Git commit 51ade094c17ae71888887de9e49a5f40effdbf38 confirms the source change, replacing canonical(CodeSystem) with uri in source/expansionprofile/expansionprofile-spreadsheet.xml. The preserved release-3 artifact tools/history/release3/profiles-resources.xml now shows ExpansionProfile.fixedVersion.system with type uri.
additional_context: ExpansionProfile is not an active current resource. source/fhir.ini contains only the commented historical note '; ExpansionProfile=approved -> dropped', current source has no active ExpansionProfile.fixedVersion definition, and later Published vocabulary issues FHIR-16337 and FHIR-16490 led to svn revision 13900 / commit 0cf4c0c96d333dbe2a5b7a5d158f7e59db4c4b5b removing ExpansionProfile and redrafting ValueSet expansion behavior.
